clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 §11 grants a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free patent license under each contributor’s essential patent claims to use and otherwise run that contributor’s contributor version.
clauses.condition_explanation: Essential patent claims are defined in §11 as claims owned or controlled by the contributor that would be infringed by a manner of making, using, or selling the contributor version permitted by the License, excluding claims infringed only because of further modification. The patent grant is limited to those claims and the contributor version.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 §11: applies to conveying a covered work when the conveyer knowingly relies on a patent license and the work’s Corresponding Source is not already available for anyone to copy free of charge under the GPL through a publicly available network server or other readily accessible means. The three compliance paths are alternatives.
clauses.condition_explanation: Knowingly relying on a patent license means actual knowledge that, but for the patent license, conveyance in a country or the recipient’s use there would infringe identifiable patents in that country that the actor has reason to believe are valid. The source-availability predicate requires public, free-of-charge copying under GPL terms. At least one of the three alternative arrangements is required, not all three.

obligation_items.content: Cause the Corresponding Source to be available for anyone to copy, free of charge and under GPL terms, through a publicly available network server or other readily accessible means.
obligation_items.object: Corresponding Source of the conveyed covered work
obligation_items.trigger: The licensee conveys a covered work, knowingly relies on a patent license, and the Corresponding Source is not already available on the specified terms and means; this is one alternative to arranging to forgo the patent-license benefit or extending the patent license downstream.

obligation_items.content: Arrange to deprive itself of the benefit of the patent license for this particular work.
obligation_items.object: Patent-license benefit for the particular covered work
obligation_items.trigger: The licensee conveys a covered work, knowingly relies on a patent license, and the Corresponding Source is not already available on the specified terms and means; this is one alternative to making the source available or extending the patent license downstream.

obligation_items.content: Arrange, consistently with GPL requirements, to extend the patent license to downstream recipients.
obligation_items.object: Patent license for downstream recipients of the covered work
obligation_items.trigger: The licensee conveys a covered work, knowingly relies on a patent license, and the Corresponding Source is not already available on the specified terms and means; this is one alternative to making the source available or arranging to forgo the patent-license benefit.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 §11: where the specified conveyance and selective patent-license grant occur in connection with a single transaction or arrangement, the patent license automatically extends to all recipients of the covered work and works based on it.
clauses.condition_explanation: The trigger includes conveying or propagating by procuring conveyance pursuant to or in connection with the single transaction or arrangement, and granting some recipients a patent license authorizing them to use, propagate, modify, or convey a specific copy. The extension occurs automatically by the license terms; no separate act by the licensee is specified.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 §11 prohibits conveying a covered work under the specified payment-and-patent-license arrangement, subject to the exception if the arrangement was entered into or the discriminatory patent license was granted before 28 March 2007. The discriminatory license must be in connection with copies conveyed by the licensee (or copies made from them), or primarily for and in connection with specific products or compilations containing the covered work.
clauses.condition_explanation: A discriminatory patent license excludes from its coverage, prohibits, or is conditioned on non-exercise of one or more rights specifically granted by the GPL. The exception applies if either the arrangement was entered into before 28 March 2007 or the discriminatory patent license was granted before that date.

obligation_items.content: Do not convey the covered work while subject to the specified third-party arrangement and discriminatory patent license.
obligation_items.trigger: The licensee is party to an arrangement with a software-distributing third party, pays based on the extent of its conveyance activity, and that third party grants recipients a discriminatory patent license in the specified connection, unless the arrangement was entered into or that license granted before 28 March 2007.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 §11 preserves implied licenses and other defenses to infringement otherwise available under applicable patent law; it does not itself create or specify such a license or defense.
clauses.condition_explanation: Otherwise available means available to the licensee under applicable patent law independent of this savings language.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 §12: external conditions do not excuse GPL conditions. If the licensee cannot convey while satisfying both GPL and other pertinent obligations, conveying is prohibited. The royalty-collection example illustrates the rule; it is not a separate cumulative requirement.
clauses.condition_explanation: An other condition includes one imposed by court order, agreement, or otherwise. The prohibition applies only when simultaneous compliance is impossible.

obligation_items.content: Do not convey the covered work when doing so cannot satisfy both the GPL conditions and the other pertinent obligations imposed on the licensee.
obligation_items.trigger: A condition is imposed on the licensee and simultaneous compliance with that condition and GPL requirements when conveying the covered work is impossible.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 §13 permits linking a covered work with an AGPL version 3 work into a single combined work. GPL terms continue to apply to the covered-work part; AGPL §13 network-interaction requirements apply to the combination as such.
clauses.condition_explanation: The permission is for the specified AGPLv3 combination into a single combined work. The detailed content of AGPL §13 is not supplied here.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 §13 permits combining a covered work with an AGPL version 3 work into a single combined work. GPL terms continue to apply to the covered-work part; AGPL §13 network-interaction requirements apply to the combination as such.
clauses.condition_explanation: The permission is for the specified AGPLv3 combination into a single combined work. The detailed content of AGPL §13 is not supplied here.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 §13 permits conveying the resulting single combined work. GPL terms continue to apply to the covered-work part; AGPL §13 network-interaction requirements apply to the combination as such.
clauses.condition_explanation: The permission is for the specified AGPLv3 combination into a single combined work. The detailed content of AGPL §13 is not supplied here.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 §14: if the Program specifies a numbered version or any later version, the licensee may choose that version or any later FSF-published version. If no version is specified, the licensee may choose any version ever published by the FSF.
clauses.condition_explanation: The two choice paths depend on whether the Program specifies a version. Version choice is optional, not a duty.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 §14: when the Program specifies a proxy to decide which future GPL versions can be used, the proxy’s public acceptance permanently authorizes the licensee to choose that version for the Program.
clauses.condition_explanation: Both the Program’s proxy designation and the proxy’s public acceptance of the version are required. This is authorization to choose, not a duty to choose.
